SELECT t.fpsyear, t.active, t.createdby, t.createdon, t.fpsyearcode, t.remarks, t.yearstatus
FROM fps.tblyearmaster AS t
WHERE t.active
ORDER BY t.fpsyear DESC

SELECT t.spnumber, t.fpsyear, t.firstname, t.lastname, t.title
FROM fps.tblemployee AS t
WHERE t.fpsyear = @ef_filter__FilterFpsYear AND t.spnumber LIKE @prefix_startswith
ORDER BY t.spnumber

SELECT t.divname, t.agencyid, t.centoverhead, t.divisionid
FROM fps.tlkpdivision AS t
ORDER BY t.divname

SELECT t0.profitcentre, t0.conttarget, t0.division, t0.divisionid, t0.email_recipient, t0.highlevelsummary, t0.outputsheet, t0.pactcoordinatoremailname, t0.profitcentrehead, t0.profitcentrename, t0.timesheet, t0.timesheetlayout
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.profitcentre, t.conttarget, t.division, t.divisionid, t.email_recipient, t.highlevelsummary, t.outputsheet, t.pactcoordinatoremailname, t.profitcentrehead, t.profitcentrename, t.timesheet, t.timesheetlayout
    FROM fps.tblkpprofitcentre AS t
) AS t0
ORDER BY t0.profitcentre

SELECT g.gradecode, g.fpsyear, g.avleavehrs, g.avsalary, g.avsickhrs, g.desc_long, g.pactcode
FROM fps.grade AS g
WHERE g.fpsyear = @ef_filter__FilterFpsYear
ORDER BY g.gradecode

ORDER BY t0.profitcentre
